settings.heading: Shipping and returns
settings.text:
Printing. Every piece is printed to order and leaves within three working days.

Delivery. Tracked post. Add your own delivery times and prices here.

Returns. Free within 30 days if unworn. Write to us with your order number and we send a label.

Exchanges. Wrong size? Send it back and order the right one; the refund goes back to your card.
